args.description: Ready-to-send body for the chosen workflow (/run/<intent>); help/out_of_scope carry `reply`; pause/resume carry person_id+paused; stop carries phone; command carries the /run/command body with args.action (report|add_family|remove_family|list_family|status|set_code_word|get_code_word|briefing|feedback|help); clarify carries `reply` (the question to send, empty for a bare forward marker such as "Fwd:") and `reason` (ambiguous|await_forward); scam_check may carry teach_wrapper=true

result.description: Present only when dispatch=true: the chosen workflow's output
